purpose: Exercise the Works/Fruit contract on real project artifacts without equating existence, completion, popularity or canon relevance with good Fruit.
rules: Unknown reception remains unknown; do not infer audience size or value from archive presence.
Creative provenance and recovery status remain separate from Fruit evaluation.
Fruit types are intended/evaluative categories, not claims that the work achieved the intended effect.
Future Seed names reusable capability the work could create; it is not evidence that the capability has already reproduced.
A Work may carry several Fruit types and risks simultaneously.

records.title: Potato of Life Growth Game
intended_audience: readers who learn better through simulation
records.intended_effect: Turn growth, inheritance, selection, seasons, tradeoffs and generational memory into playable state transitions.
records.claim/evidence_boundary: Simulation outcomes are consequences of its rules; they are not biological or economic evidence unless independently calibrated.
externalities_or_risks: systems may imply false biological realism if mechanics are not labeled as abstractions
optimization can crowd out the project's cultivation/variety themes
future_seed: reusable simulation engine for Seed→Root→Tree→Fruit cycles
teaching module for inheritance and tradeoffs
records.revision_status: concept/archive stage; implementation maturity should be tracked separately from design

records.title: Tim Dooley Trading Game
intended_audience: players interested in market interfaces and Potato humor
records.intended_effect: Make price signals, attention, narrative and feedback visible through a playful market-style interface.
records.claim/evidence_boundary: The interface is not a market-data authority and simulated behavior is not evidence about real asset prices.
externalities_or_risks: could be mistaken for financial guidance if real-looking tickers are insufficiently bounded
attention mechanics may reward noise rather than learning

records.title: Self-Playing AI Potato Town
records.intended_effect: Compress time so local rules, agent interaction, seasonal change and threshold events generate inspectable larger stories.
records.claim/evidence_boundary: Emergence inside the simulation demonstrates properties of the implemented rules, not spontaneous evidence for Potatoverse cosmology or real social systems.
externalities_or_risks: confusing generated narrative with autonomous intelligence
over-reading small-rule simulations as social proof

records.title: Secret Hidden Esoteric Potato School (Advanced)
intended_audience: readers who enjoy absurdist interactive teaching
records.intended_effect: Teach cultivation, thresholds and discernment through quests while parodying prestige, tuition, credentials and esoteric gatekeeping.
records.claim/evidence_boundary: It is a creative teaching satire, not a real secret institution, credential or required initiation.

needed: which lessons transfer outside the game

externalities_or_risks: satire can accidentally reproduce the prestige/exclusion mechanics it mocks
hidden-door framing can be misread as real authority
records.revision_status: memory-recovery source; original specification still needs recovery

records.title: Dense Potatoverse Poetry
intended_audience: readers drawn to compressed symbolic language and performance cadence
records.intended_effect: Compress many recurring motifs into rhythm so relations can be felt, remembered and recombined outside expository prose.
records.claim/evidence_boundary: Symbolic density can reveal project associations but is not independent evidence for historical, scientific or theological claims.
externalities_or_risks: dense association can make accidental proximity look like causal relation
records.revision_status: living creative form; individual artifacts need dated provenance

records.title: Sermon / Comedy / Speech Hybrid
intended_audience: live or written audiences able to distinguish serious argument from parody
records.intended_effect: Use register switching between sermon, rant, comedy and systems analysis to lower prestige barriers and expose contradictions.
records.claim/evidence_boundary: Rhetorical force, sacred register or audience laughter does not establish factual truth.

needed: whether satire reduces or increases confusion

externalities_or_risks: register shifts can blur literal and comic claims
institutional critique can become personal caricature if boundaries fail

records.title: Suno Music Archive
records.intended_effect: Carry project mood, cadence, motifs and narrative through sound while preserving dated creative experiments.
records.claim/evidence_boundary: Songs are creative artifacts and provenance records; lyrical assertions are not independent factual evidence.

observable_reception.boundary: Do not infer truth or value directly from play counts.

externalities_or_risks: generated-music authorship/provenance can blur if prompts and outputs are not linked
lyric compression can backdate later canon if chronology is ignored
records.revision_status: active archive; continue source and date normalization

records.title: Visual Art & Symbolic Composition Corpus
records.intended_effect: Make project relationships spatially inspectable and preserve the evolution of compositions that prose alone can flatten.
records.claim/evidence_boundary: A compelling composition is a visual interpretation, not empirical evidence or proof of scriptural/historical identity.
externalities_or_risks: visual proximity can imply false identity
AI-generated style/content provenance can be lost
symbolic imagery can overpower textual evidence boundaries

coverage.next_wave_rule: Prefer artifacts with recoverable owner/provenance; memory-recovered works may be instrumented only when their uncertainty remains explicit.
